zh.window_title: HypoMux - Windows 多网卡双协议分流加速
zh.subtitle: 多网卡 HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS 分流引擎 · 实时分流大屏
zh.status_loading: 状态: 正在加载网卡...
zh.status_no_adapters: 状态: 未找到可用的网卡
zh.status_loaded: 状态: 已加载 {count} 个网卡，就绪
zh.status_starting: 状态: 正在启动双协议分流引擎...
zh.status_running: 状态: 双协议分流引擎运行中 @ {endpoint}
zh.status_running_live: 状态: 分流运行中 · 下行 {down:.2f} MB/s · 连接 {conn}
zh.warn_boosting_refresh: 加速运行中，请先停止再刷新网卡
zh.warn_no_adapters: 未找到任何可用的网卡
zh.warn_no_selection: 请先勾选至少一张拥有有效 IPv4 的网卡
zh.warn_steam_running: 检测到 Steam 正在运行，请重启 Steam 客户端以使多链路加速完全生效。
zh.warn_foreign_tun_route: 检测到第三方虚拟隧道 {name} 正在接管默认路由，请先关闭该代理或 VPN 后再启动虚拟网卡模式
zh.log_steam_running: [警告] 检测到 Steam 正在运行，请重启 Steam 客户端以使多链路加速完全生效。
zh.error_proxy_write:
双协议引擎已监听，但无法写入 Windows 系统代理:

{error}
zh.settings_system_proxy_takeover: 接管 Windows 系统代理
zh.settings_system_proxy_takeover_hint: 开启后，系统代理模式会自动配置 Windows；关闭后仅开放本地 HTTP/SOCKS5 端口，供下载器等应用手动使用。更改将在下次启动聚合时生效。
zh.settings_system_proxy_takeover_on: 已开启系统代理接管，下次启动聚合时生效
zh.settings_system_proxy_takeover_off: 已关闭系统代理接管，下次启动聚合时仅开放本地端口
zh.settings_autostart_hint: 开机时静默启动并最小化到系统托盘
zh.settings_autostart_failed: 开机自启设置失败，请检查系统权限
zh.settings_auto_start_engine_hint: 需先开启开机自启；届时将使用上次保存的模式和网卡自动启动加速
zh.settings_auto_start_engine_failed: 自动启动加速设置失败
zh.diag_no_selection: 请先勾选至少一张拥有有效 IPv4 的网卡再进行体检
zh.diag_desc_available: 链路稳定，0 丢包，延迟抖动极低，可放心加入加速池。
zh.diag_desc_unstable: 链路存在波动：丢包或抖动偏高，加速时可能出现卡顿。
zh.diag_desc_unavailable: 链路不可用：100% 丢包或源 IP 绑定失败（可能是网卡被架空/掉线）。
zh.virtual_adapters_hint: 在 Hyper-V 外部交换机上批量创建宿主机虚拟网卡。每张卡拥有唯一 MAC，路由器会按 MAC 分别分配 IP，从而绕开每 MAC 的限速配额。
zh.virtual_adapters_quota_line: 已创建 {used} / {total} 张虚拟网卡，本轮最多还能创建 {remaining} 张。
zh.virtual_adapters_quota_exceeded: 已创建 {used} / {total} 张虚拟网卡，本轮最多还能创建 {remaining} 张。请把创建数量改成 {max} 以内再提交。
zh.virtual_adapters_quota_exhausted: 已创建 {used} / {total} 张虚拟网卡，已达上限，本轮无法再创建。请先删除不再使用的虚拟网卡。
zh.virtual_adapters_switch_hint: 宿主机虚拟网卡必须挂在允许管理操作系统（AllowManagementOS）的外部交换机上。
zh.virtual_adapters_no_switch: 未找到可用的外部交换机。请先在 Hyper-V 管理器中创建一个外部交换机。
zh.virtual_adapters_switch_external_only: 仅外部交换机（可绑定宿主机网卡）
zh.virtual_adapters_switch_management_os_of: 宿主机上有 {count} 个外部交换机，但都没勾选「允许管理操作系统」（AllowManagementOS）。请打开 Hyper-V 管理器 → 左侧「虚拟交换机」→ 选中这些交换机 → 属性 → 管理操作系统 勾选「允许」→ 确定，然后回来重试。
zh.virtual_adapters_switch_none_usable: 本机的外部交换机都没有勾选「允许管理操作系统」（AllowManagementOS），且无法自动判定原因。请打开 Hyper-V 管理器 → 「虚拟交换机」→ 属性 → 管理操作系统 勾选「允许」，或新建一个外部交换机。
zh.virtual_adapters_empty: 还没有虚拟网卡（Hyper-V）。点击「批量创建」开始。
zh.virtual_adapters_state_dhcp: 等待 DHCP 分配 IP
zh.virtual_adapters_hint_pool_restart: 这张卡真正写进出口池要等聚合引擎重启之后。重启聚合引擎，再回来确认这张卡是否显示「已加入出口池」。
zh.virtual_adapters_hint_pool_update_failed: 网卡本身已经创建成功，但没有写进出口池；重启聚合引擎也不会生效。请删除这张卡后重新创建，或检查 settings.json 里的出口池配置。
zh.virtual_adapters_dhcp_slow: 超过 60 秒仍未拿到 IP，请检查路由器 DHCP 地址池是否已满。
zh.virtual_adapters_create_banner: 正在创建 {count} 张虚拟网卡，请勿关闭窗口或断开网络。
zh.virtual_adapters_restart_hint: 创建完成后需要重启聚合引擎，出口池才会生效。
zh.virtual_adapters_restart_pending: 出口池是否写入还没有确认，需要重启聚合引擎后才生效：{names}。重启后请确认这几张卡仍然显示「已加入出口池」；如果没有，请删除后重新创建。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_body: 该卡将从宿主机移除，路由器分配给它的 IP 配额会被回收。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_foreign_body: 这张虚拟网卡不是本工具创建的，删除后无法撤销，也无法由本工具恢复。请确认下面这张卡确实是需要删除的。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_body: 以下网卡会在一次提权操作中一并删除，只弹一次权限提示。删除后无法撤销。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_warning: 其中 {count} 张不是本工具创建的，删除后无法由本工具恢复，请逐项确认。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_ok: 已删除 {count} 张虚拟网卡。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_partial: 已删除 {count} 张虚拟网卡，其余未删除成功：
zh.virtual_adapters_reserved_hint: Hyper-V 自己使用的网卡（容器网络 / 默认交换机），删除会中断容器与 Docker 网络。
zh.virtual_adapters_preview: 浏览器预览 · 以下为示例数据，未连接桌面服务。
zh.virtual_adapters_switch_failed: 无法读取 Hyper-V 交换机列表，批量创建暂不可用。请检查 Hyper-V 是否已安装、是否以管理员权限运行，然后重试。
zh.virtual_adapters_read_failed: 读取虚拟网卡列表失败：列表是旧的，不代表网卡状态已改变。请点「重试」再读一次，暂时不要重复创建或删除。
zh.virtual_adapters_create_failed: 创建虚拟网卡失败：宿主机上没有新增网卡。请查看下面的错误原因，修正后重试；已经建成功的网卡不受影响。
zh.virtual_adapters_remove_failed: 删除虚拟网卡失败：网卡仍留在宿主机上。请查看下面的错误原因后重试，或重启 HypoMux 后再删一次，以免留下孤儿网卡。
zh.home_engine_control_hint: 启动后将使用已勾选网卡进行聚合分流。
zh.home_no_adapters: 未发现可用网卡，请点击刷新重试
zh.routing_hint: 按进程、域名或 IP 指定出口；同时命中多类规则时，按所选匹配顺序处理。
zh.routing_duplicate_hint: 检测到重复分流规则：{names}。运行时将以第一条为准，请删除或修改重复项。
zh.routing_invalid_hint: 以下规则格式无效，保存时会跳过：{values}
zh.routing_duplicate_process: 进程 {name} 已存在，请直接编辑原规则。
zh.routing_restart_required: 分流规则已保存，重启加速后生效。
zh.routing_export_success: 已导出 {count} 条分流规则。
zh.routing_import_confirm_content: 将用导入的 {count} 条规则替换当前规则表，是否继续？
zh.routing_import_success: 已导入 {count} 条分流规则。
zh.rulesets_hint: 订阅类似 Clash / sing-box 的域名分类列表，把一整类网络一键指定到某个出口，无需逐条填写域名。
zh.rulesets_empty: 还没有规则集；在下方添加订阅地址即可按类别分流。
zh.rulesets_update_success: 规则集已更新并热加载。
zh.rulesets_delete_confirm: 删除规则集“{name}”？将清空正在使用的匹配内容，重启加速后彻底移除引用。
zh.rulesets_url_placeholder: https://... （sing-box 源 JSON 或 Clash 负载 YAML）
zh.rulesets_restart_hint: 内容与优先级更新、停用和删除会热加载；新增或修改出口后需重启加速。启用尚未加载的规则集也需重启。仅在 TUN 模式下生效。
zh.tun_need_admin_content: 虚拟网卡模式需要系统管理员权限以创建 TUN 加速设备。请右键点击 HypoMux 并选择「以管理员身份运行」，或者切换回「系统代理模式」继续使用。
zh.tun_starting: 正在启动虚拟网卡内核...
zh.tun_started: 虚拟网卡内核已接管全局流量
zh.tun_validating: 正在验证虚拟网卡的 DNS 与 HTTPS 联网能力
zh.tun_validation_failed: 虚拟网卡联网验证失败，已自动停止并恢复网络设置
zh.tun_validation_timeout: 虚拟网卡联网验证超时，已自动停止并恢复网络设置
zh.tun_watchdog_rollback: 检测到物理网络正常但虚拟网卡连续无法联网，已自动停止加速并恢复网络设置
zh.tun_force_started: 已强制启动虚拟网卡：未验证联网可用性；若无法联网请手动停止加速。
zh.tun_unexpected_stop: 虚拟网卡内核意外停止，已自动回滚并恢复网络设置
zh.tun_singbox_missing: 未找到 bin/sing-box.exe，无法启用虚拟网卡模式
zh.tun_pool_start_timeout: 出站池启动超时，已取消虚拟网卡接管
zh.tools_hint: 调用 Rust 诊断内核，对选中网卡逐张发射 ICMP 探针，评估丢包与抖动，给出红/黄/绿三级链路质量。
zh.tools_no_result: 尚未体检，点击上方按钮开始。
zh.settings_theme_hint: 切换浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统
zh.settings_theme_color_hint: 选择默认蓝色，或自定义按钮、高亮和交互状态的强调色
zh.settings_mica_effect_hint: 使用 Windows 11 云母半透明背景；可即时切换且不会闪屏
zh.settings_mica_effect_background_hint: 已启用自定义背景图，背景图优先显示；清除后可重新调整云母效果
zh.settings_background_image_hint: 选择图片作为软件窗口背景，图片会复制到本地配置目录
zh.settings_background_image_invalid: 无法读取该图片，请选择 PNG、JPG、BMP 或 WebP 图片
zh.settings_background_image_save_failed: 保存背景图片失败，请检查配置目录权限
zh.settings_content_card_opacity_hint: 仅在使用自定义背景图时生效；提高数值可增强文字可读性
zh.settings_advanced_network: 高级网络 / 特殊网络环境
zh.settings_force_tun_hint: 跳过 DNS 联网验证、启动及运行期联网探测；环境检查不会阻止启动。仍需有效网卡、核心文件和管理员授权，实际创建失败会报错。若无法联网请手动停止。
zh.settings_wfp_strict_route: 严格路由与 DNS 防泄漏（WFP）
zh.settings_wfp_strict_route_hint: 阻止 Windows 多网卡 DNS 绕过虚拟网卡。默认开启；不兼容的设备会仅对本机自动降级为兼容 TUN。
zh.settings_wfp_repair: 网络组件与 TUN 兼容性
zh.settings_wfp_repair_unknown: 尚未检测。不会在 HypoMux 启动时创建虚拟网卡。
zh.settings_blocked_domains_manage_hint: 查看、刷新或清除已自动记录的域名。
zh.settings_dns_server: 传统 DNS 兜底服务器
zh.settings_dns_fallback_hint: DoH 不可用或关闭时，作为 53 端口解析服务器使用
zh.settings_doh_hint: 默认自动优选 HTTPS/443 DoH；关闭后仅使用绑定到所选网卡的传统 DNS（UDP/TCP 53）。
zh.settings_dns_egress_hint: 自动模式优先跟随 IPv4/IPv6 默认分流规则，其次跟随 Windows 默认路由；也可固定到已启用网卡。
zh.settings_dns_invalid: DNS 地址格式无效，请输入合法 IPv4 地址
zh.settings_dns_save_failed: DNS 设置保存失败，请检查配置文件权限
zh.blocked_hint: 当某网卡连接目标域名失败、但其他网卡可连通时，自动记录该域名为该网卡的黑名单。后续分流将自动规避。
zh.blocked_enable_hint: 开启后与加速引擎捆绑生效；关闭后暂停规避功能。仅建议学校/企业有特殊需求的用户使用，普通家庭用户不建议使用。
zh.blocked_no_data: 暂无记录，在加速期间遇到连通失败的域名将在此显示
zh.blocked_expiry_hint: 开启后黑名单条目 30 分钟后自动恢复。关闭后条目永不自动移除。
zh.home_weighted_hint: 按网卡相对权重分配新连接；默认权重相等。关闭后采用轮询均分。
zh.home_bw_column_hint: 相对比例：数值越大，分配到的新连接越多；默认均为 1，不会限制网卡速度。

en.subtitle: Multi-NIC HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS Splitting Engine · Live Dashboard
en.warn_boosting_refresh: Boosting in progress, stop first before refreshing
en.warn_no_selection: Please select at least one adapter with a valid IPv4
en.warn_steam_running: Steam is running. Please restart the Steam client for multi-link acceleration to take full effect.
en.warn_foreign_tun_route: Detected third-party virtual tunnel {name} taking over the default route. Close that proxy or VPN before starting Virtual NIC mode.
en.log_steam_running: [Warning] Steam is running. Please restart the Steam client for multi-link acceleration to take full effect.
en.error_proxy_write:
Engine is listening but cannot write system proxy:

{error}
en.settings_system_proxy_takeover_hint: When enabled, System Proxy mode configures Windows automatically. Disable it to expose only the local HTTP/SOCKS5 ports for downloaders and other manually configured apps. Changes apply on the next start.
en.settings_system_proxy_takeover_on: Windows system-proxy management enabled for the next start
en.settings_system_proxy_takeover_off: Windows system-proxy management disabled; the next start will expose local ports only
en.settings_autostart_hint: Start silently and minimize to the system tray on boot
en.settings_autostart_failed: Failed to set launch at startup, check system permissions
en.settings_auto_start_engine_hint: Requires launch at startup; HypoMux will start acceleration with the last saved mode and adapters
en.settings_auto_start_engine_failed: Failed to configure automatic acceleration at boot
en.diag_no_selection: Select at least one adapter with a valid IPv4 before the health check
en.diag_desc_available: Stable link, 0 packet loss, very low jitter. Safe to add to the boost pool.
en.diag_desc_unstable: Link fluctuates: packet loss or jitter is high, stutter may occur while boosting.
en.diag_desc_unavailable: Link unavailable: 100% packet loss or source IP bind failure (adapter may be down/superseded).
en.virtual_adapters_hint: Create host virtual NICs in bulk on a Hyper-V external switch. Each adapter gets a unique MAC, so your router assigns it an IP of its own and the per-MAC rate limit no longer caps your total speed.
en.virtual_adapters_quota_line: {used} of {total} virtual adapters created — at most {remaining} more in this batch.
en.virtual_adapters_quota_exceeded: {used} of {total} virtual adapters created, so only {remaining} more fit in this batch. Enter {max} or fewer and submit again.
en.virtual_adapters_quota_exhausted: All {total} virtual adapter slots are taken ({used} created), so nothing more can be created right now. Delete the adapters you no longer use first.
en.virtual_adapters_switch_hint: Host virtual NICs must sit on an external switch that allows the management operating system (AllowManagementOS).
en.virtual_adapters_no_switch: No usable external switch was found. Create an external switch in Hyper-V Manager first.
en.virtual_adapters_switch_external_only: External switch only (can bind host NICs)
en.virtual_adapters_switch_management_os_of: This host has {count} external switch(es), but none of them has "Allow management operating system" (AllowManagementOS) ticked. In Hyper-V Manager, go to Virtual Switches, select these switches, open Properties, tick Allow under "Management operating system", confirm, then come back and retry.
en.virtual_adapters_switch_none_usable: None of the external switches on this host has "Allow management operating system" (AllowManagementOS) ticked, and the exact reason cannot be determined automatically. In Hyper-V Manager, open Virtual Switches → Properties → Management operating system and tick Allow, or create a new external switch.
en.virtual_adapters_empty: No virtual NICs (Hyper-V) yet. Use "Create in bulk" to start.
en.virtual_adapters_hint_pool_restart: This adapter only really joins the outbound pool after you restart the aggregation engine. Restart it, then come back and check whether the pool badge is there.
en.virtual_adapters_hint_pool_update_failed: The adapter itself was created, but it did not make it into the outbound pool, and restarting the aggregation engine will not change that. Delete this adapter and create it again, or check the outbound pool configuration in settings.json.
en.virtual_adapters_dhcp_slow: Still no IP after 60 seconds — check whether your router's DHCP pool is exhausted.
en.virtual_adapters_create_banner: Creating {count} virtual NICs. Do not close the window or disconnect the network.
en.virtual_adapters_restart_hint: The aggregation engine must restart after creation before the outbound pool takes effect.
en.virtual_adapters_restart_pending: The outbound pool write is not confirmed yet, so it only takes effect once you restart the aggregation engine: {names}. After restarting, check that these adapters still show "In outbound pool"; if they do not, remove and create them again.
en.virtual_adapters_remove_body: The adapter is removed from the host and the IP lease your router assigned it is released.
en.virtual_adapters_remove_foreign_body: This virtual NIC was not created by HypoMux. Deleting it cannot be undone, and HypoMux cannot restore it. Check that the adapter below is the one you mean.
en.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_body: The adapters below are deleted in one elevated run, so you are prompted once. Deleting them cannot be undone.
en.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_warning: {count} of them were not created by HypoMux and cannot be restored once deleted. Check every entry.
en.virtual_adapters_remove_selected_partial: Deleted {count}; the rest were not removed:
en.virtual_adapters_reserved_hint: Used by Hyper-V itself (container networking and the default switch). Deleting it breaks container and Docker networking.
en.virtual_adapters_preview: Browser preview · Sample data only; the desktop service is not connected.
en.virtual_adapters_switch_failed: The Hyper-V switch list could not be read, so creating virtual NICs is unavailable. Check that Hyper-V is installed and that HypoMux runs elevated, then retry.
en.virtual_adapters_read_failed: Reading the virtual NIC list failed: what you see is stale and does not mean the adapters changed. Press Retry to read it again, and do not create or remove anything in the meantime.
en.virtual_adapters_create_failed: Creating virtual NICs failed: no adapter was added to the host. Read the reason below, fix it and retry — the adapters that did get created are unaffected.
en.virtual_adapters_remove_failed: Removing a virtual NIC failed: it is still on the host. Read the reason below and retry, or restart HypoMux and remove it again, so you do not leave an orphaned adapter behind.
en.home_engine_control_hint: Use the selected adapters for aggregated traffic splitting.
en.home_no_adapters: No available adapters, click refresh to retry
en.routing_hint: Choose an egress by process, domain or IP. When multiple types match, the selected order decides which takes precedence.
en.routing_duplicate_hint: Duplicate split rules detected: {names}. The first rule takes precedence; remove or edit duplicates.
en.routing_invalid_hint: These rules are invalid and will be skipped when saved: {values}
en.routing_duplicate_process: Process {name} already exists. Edit the existing rule instead.
en.routing_restart_required: Split rules were saved and will apply after acceleration is restarted.
en.routing_import_confirm_content: Replace the current rule table with {count} imported rule(s)?
en.rulesets_hint: Subscribe to Clash / sing-box style domain category lists and route a whole category through one outbound without typing domains one by one.
en.rulesets_empty: No rule sets yet; add a subscription below to route by category.
en.rulesets_update_failed: Failed to update the rule set: {error}
en.rulesets_delete_confirm: Delete rule set "{name}"? Its active matches will be cleared; restart aggregation to remove its reference.
en.rulesets_url_placeholder: https://... (sing-box source JSON or Clash payload YAML)
en.rulesets_restart_hint: Content, priority, disabling and deletion changes hot-reload. Adding, rebinding or enabling a list not yet loaded requires a restart. Rule sets apply in TUN mode only.
en.tun_need_admin_content: Virtual NIC mode requires administrator privileges to create the TUN acceleration device. Right-click HypoMux and choose Run as administrator, or switch back to System Proxy Mode to continue.
en.tun_started: Virtual NIC kernel has taken over global traffic
en.tun_validating: Validating DNS and HTTPS connectivity through the virtual NIC
en.tun_validation_failed: Virtual NIC connectivity validation failed. Acceleration was stopped and network settings were restored.
en.tun_validation_timeout: Virtual NIC connectivity validation timed out. Acceleration was stopped and network settings were restored.
en.tun_watchdog_rollback: The physical network is available, but the virtual NIC repeatedly failed. Acceleration was stopped and network settings were restored.
en.tun_force_started: Virtual NIC force-started without connectivity validation. Stop acceleration manually if connectivity is unavailable.
en.tun_unexpected_stop: Virtual NIC kernel stopped unexpectedly. Acceleration was rolled back and network settings were restored.
en.tun_singbox_missing: bin/sing-box.exe not found, cannot enable Virtual NIC mode
en.tun_pool_start_timeout: Outbound pool startup timed out; Virtual NIC takeover was cancelled
en.tools_hint: Invoke the Rust diagnostic kernel to send ICMP probes per selected adapter, measuring loss and jitter for a red/yellow/green quality grade.
en.tools_no_result: No results yet. Click the button above to start.
en.settings_theme_hint: Switch between light / dark / follow system
en.settings_theme_color_hint: Choose the default blue or customize the accent for buttons, highlights and interactive states
en.settings_mica_effect_hint: Use the Windows 11 Mica translucent background; switches instantly without flicker
en.settings_mica_effect_background_hint: A custom background is active and takes priority. Clear it to adjust the Mica effect again.
en.settings_background_image_hint: Choose an image for the app window background; it is copied to the local configuration folder
en.settings_background_image_invalid: This image cannot be read. Choose a PNG, JPG, BMP, or WebP image
en.settings_background_image_save_failed: Unable to save the background image. Check configuration folder permissions
en.settings_content_card_opacity_hint: Only active with a custom background. Raise it to improve text readability.
en.settings_force_tun_hint: Skip DNS reachability checks and startup/runtime connectivity probes. Environment checks cannot block startup. Valid adapters, core files and elevation are still required; actual creation failures are reported. Stop manually if connectivity is lost.
en.settings_wfp_strict_route: Strict routing and DNS leak protection (WFP)
en.settings_wfp_strict_route_hint: Prevents Windows multi-homed DNS from bypassing TUN. Enabled by default; incompatible devices fall back to compatible TUN only on this device.
en.settings_wfp_repair_unknown: Not checked yet. No virtual adapter is created when HypoMux starts.
en.settings_blocked_domains_manage_hint: View, refresh, or clear automatically recorded domains.
en.settings_dns_fallback_hint: Used for port-53 resolution when DoH is unavailable or disabled
en.settings_doh_hint: Auto prefers HTTPS/443 DoH. When off, only selected-interface traditional DNS (UDP/TCP 53) is used.
en.settings_dns_egress_hint: Auto follows IPv4/IPv6 default routing rules first, then the Windows default route. You can also pin DNS to an enabled adapter.
en.settings_dns_invalid: Invalid DNS address, enter a valid IPv4 address
en.settings_dns_save_failed: Failed to save DNS settings, check config file permissions
en.blocked_hint: When a domain fails to connect on one NIC but works on others, it is automatically recorded as blocked for that NIC. Future connections will bypass the blocked NIC.
en.blocked_enable_hint: Bundled with the acceleration engine when enabled; paused when disabled. Recommended only for school/enterprise users with special needs; not advised for regular home users.
en.blocked_no_data: No records yet. Domains that fail on some NICs during acceleration will appear here.
en.blocked_expiry_hint: When enabled, blocked entries auto-recover after 30 min. When disabled, entries never expire automatically.
en.home_weighted_hint: Distribute new connections by relative NIC weight; all weights are equal by default. Disable for round-robin.
en.home_bw_column_hint: Relative ratio: higher values receive more new connections. Default is 1 and this never rate-limits a NIC.
